scope: C09-C12 source-grounded feature-space adaptations; no training or performance claim

methods.name: Recurrent Kalman Network
preserved: Observable upper and recurrent lower state, with upper/lower/side covariance vectors
Softmax mixture of 15 learned banded transition bases, bandwidth 3
Locally linear prior propagation plus learned positive diagonal process noise
Encoded normalized Gaussian observations with learned positive variance
Kalman upper and lower gains and covariance conditioning
adaptations: Observed key/value slots become feature-space Gaussian observations per OSRAM head
Independent available observations combine in information form before conditioning
Queries read the predicted prior before current-observation assimilation
Query-conditioned linear feature decoder replaces the source task decoder
No task uncertainty calibration claim; source latent filtering core retained
methods.insertion: replaces recurrent memory backend, rather than filtering an existing OSRAM read

methods.name: Particle Filter Recurrent Neural Network (PF-GRU)
methods.method_sections: Particle Filter Extension to RNNs; stochastic memory, weight update, soft-resampling equations 1-3
methods.author_identity: Xiao Ma; paper footnote links this repository
preserved: 16 persistent particles per conversation and head, shared learned PF-GRU parameters
Reparameterized Gaussian transition noise and reset/update gates
Learned observation scores accumulate in normalized log weights
Soft proposal q=0.5*w+0.5/K, sampled ancestors, normalized importance correction w/q
Weighted particle mean drives memory reads
adaptations: Observed key/value slots supply controls and observations after history read
No observations: autonomous transition, no observation weight update or resampling
LayerNorm over each particle feature vector replaces author BatchNorm1d(K) to prevent cross-conversation statistics
Task objective remains host prediction loss; optional source per-particle auxiliary ELBO is not implemented
The source PF-GRU core is retained, not a claim of the author's full best-performing training recipe
methods.insertion: replaces recurrent memory backend, rather than post-read gating

methods.name: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts VAE
methods.method_sections: 3 Methods; joint generative model, mixture posterior, stratified objective equations 1-3
preserved: Separate unimodal posterior encoders and trained likelihood decoders reconstructing original observed modality features, with modality-specific output dimensions
Uniform mixture over available posterior experts, with missing expert weight exactly zero
Stratified K=1 mixture ELBO: all available conditional likelihoods plus log prior minus log mixture posterior
Reparameterized training samples and differentiable mixture density, including the full variational generative objective
adaptations: Gaussian distributions model original observed continuous modality features; posterior encoders consume learned feature latents, and decoder targets are original inputs rather than those trainable latents
K=1 is the complete ELBO case; multi-sample IWAE and DReG estimators are not claimed
Available subsets supply both inference experts and likelihood targets; unavailable targets are never accessed
Task representation is the deterministic mixture posterior mean during both training and inference; stochastic samples serve the complete generative ELBO auxiliary objective
Evaluation skips the generative objective and likelihood decoders entirely; no reconstruction targets are required, and no generated feature is written into observed memory
methods.integration_requirement: Construct MMVAE(latent_dim, reconstruction_dims={audio:adim,text:tdim,visual:vdim}), supply original raw observed features as reconstruction_targets during training, and add returned generative_loss to the objective. Retaining only representation or reconstructing learned posterior inputs would not implement this full generative transfer.

methods.name: Natural Posterior Network (normal regression)
methods.method_sections: 3.2 input-dependent conjugate update, normalized flow density; Bayesian loss and Table 1 normal-gamma algebra
preserved: Per-input latent encoder and normalized radial-flow density with exact Jacobian
Normal likelihood parameters supply expected sufficient statistics
Density-scaled evidence and normal certainty budget; source gradient-preserving evidence clamp
NormalGamma prior mean 0, scale 10, evidence 1 and conjugate parameter update
Student-t posterior predictive mean, degrees of freedom and scale
Task loss is expected Normal NLL minus posterior entropy; flow gradients arise through evidence
adaptations: Host 1600-dimensional hidden feature encoder, 16-dimensional latent space and four radial flow layers
Posterior entropy weight fixed to 1e-5; host must record this objective and head change
No batch normalization, density caches, test-batch adaptation or gold targets in forward
methods.integration_requirement: Replace task head and task loss with returned posterior and Bayesian loss; MSE-only training must not be labeled NatPN. Keep matched head/objective control in experiment record.
